title: Chapter 23: Work-For-Relief
content:
Chapter 23: Work-For-Relief

Wu Qing still felt that the room generated in the mother nest was comfortable to live in, so he didn't plan to go to the lord's castle in Huaxia Territory.

Thinking of the former lord and his subordinates, he felt that he couldn't stay in that castle.

"Tear it down! It must be demolished!"

Thinking of this problem, Wu Qing considered the development of Daxia Territory again. Now the residents of the territory can't even get enough food, and the people's hearts are unstable due to a series of changes.

Something must be done to stabilize the people's hearts and improve the living conditions of the residents.

Although these people are not human, they are indeed living intelligent creatures.

In these alien worlds, Wu Qing's racial prejudice is not strong. Anyway, they can't be from the same race as him.

Here, if the human race is his enemy, he will definitely beat them without hesitation.

Wu Qing is a person who has received a good modern ideological and moral education. He understands the truth that officials should make decisions for the people. Although this is an alien world, he still wants to do it just to be better for the people under his rule.

After all, the territory's luck still depends on the people. He believes that the residents of those powerful territories must live better than the residents here, otherwise how can the territory be strong?

Wu Qing wants to demolish the castle, so he must have people to do the work. The residents of the territory are not well fed now, so he immediately thought of a term "work-for-relief".

Ask the residents to help with the work, give them some food, and by the way, replan and rebuild the entire town.

Wu Qing doesn't like this town at all. If it weren't for the lack of manpower and the weird appearance at night, he might have ordered the demolition of the city and the reconstruction of a new one.

The plan is there, but the question is where the food comes from?

Judging from the situation, the food in the fields outside the city will take at least a month to mature, and there are no mature fruits on the fruit trees at this time.

As for meat, the original city lord seems to have never developed animal husbandry. Regardless of the race, people are basically vegetarians.

Fortunately, although the aliens in this world seem to have a lot to do with various beasts, they are actually considered humans. They are omnivorous animals and can eat anything.

As for hunting, it is an activity that only the lord and a few people can do. Ordinary people dare not go out of the territory in broad daylight.

It is rare for someone like Hu Tu to have a certain family heritage and unfortunately become a lonely person.

The reason why he ran out alone to observe the bear goblins was that he was a newborn calf who was not afraid of tigers, and no one cared about him.

He was lucky to meet Wu Qing. There must be many young men like him who stayed in the wild forever.

Wu Qing entered the field of vision of the puppy exploring in the wild, observed the animals and plants in the wild, and passed the collected information to the Queen of Insects.

The Queen of Insects was asked to communicate with the sheep elders who often dealt with animals and plants through the identity card to confirm which plants in the wild can be used as food and which animals can be eaten.

Wu Qing then sent the puppy to explore the wild and forests around the Great Xia Territory, counting the distribution of edible plants and estimating the yield, and counting the distribution density of edible animals and other information.

After an afternoon of statistical analysis, Wu Qing had some ideas about the source of food at this stage.

It was getting dark, and the world was about to change drastically.

"Amazing world!"

For several days, Wu Qing would watch the world turn dark at dusk and appreciate its magical charm.

In Daxia Territory, all residents who had worked all day returned to the city. They simply filled their stomachs and went to bed quickly, so as not to be too hungry to sleep at night.

Wu Qing had the energy supplements of the Zerg, so he didn't need to eat, drink, defecate or urinate. His mouth was full, and he had no desire to eat unless he encountered the delicacies of this world.

He climbed to the top of the mother nest and lay down, looking at the sky of this world that was about to turn dark. He had never seen the moon or the stars, as if all the celestial bodies in this world were left with only one sun.

The sun completely disappeared, and the world changed, as if it was covered with a layer of gauze, or as if a layer of light fog had risen. After a while, it would enter complete darkness.

Fortunately, the Zerg were not afraid of darkness, and could see things at night, and could also see things through mental induction.

After the systematic evolution of Wu Qing, although his physical strength was gone, his mental power was still very strong compared to ordinary people.

In addition, as the master of the collective consciousness of the Zerg, he has gained the blessing that he can see at night as if he wanted to.

All Zerg units returned safely to the Zerg territory and Daxia territory.

As Wu Qing expected, the terrifying weird that sang songs for him did not appear tonight. The Zerg territory has now been protected by the rules of the lord's authority in this world. No matter what weird you are, you can't break through the restrictions of this world rule.

The weird appeared, and Wu Qing began to pull the weird wool in both territories at the same time.

It was still the old routine. The Zerg army gathered at the edge of the territory, the puppy went to attract monsters, the hydralisk attacked, and the puppy and the host were on guard.

The weirds are estimated to refresh every night. Tonight, I pulled a few waves of wool, and those weirds were not fooled.

Of course, it is also possible that these weirds are forgetful.

After pulling the wool of the weirds, Wu Qing stopped. It is really very dangerous in the wild. With the current spiritual power of the queen, it also senses the potential crisis. It is not recommended that Wu Qing take risks.

At the end of the day, Wu Qing lay in bed and continued to plan the development of the Zerg territory.

Since the troops had stopped being dispatched, energy resources were not consumed in large quantities. In one afternoon, 10 new nests had been built in the valley, and a total of 30 nests were distributed throughout the valley.

The corresponding defensive spikes and anti-aircraft towers have also been built. These facilities form the defense system of the Zerg territory. Even if there are no Zerg combat troops stationed, ordinary enemies cannot attack.

The Zerg territory covering the entire valley is roughly a slightly elongated oval.

Most of the trees in the territory are left, enough to cover the obvious characteristics of the Zerg buildings, so that they are not too conspicuous from the outside.

Wu Qing reserved a little gas resources for emergency, and all the other gas was used to hatch hydralisks.

After formulating a plan, the specific operation can be handed over to the Queen of the Zerg, and he can sleep well.

In this world, for him, hard training is not very meaningful, it is better to have a good sleep.

Without the weird harassment, he slept very well that night.

Early in the morning, the Queen of the Zerg had sent a large number of puppies according to the plan he formulated to continue to expand the map.

After doing a set of body-building boxing and stretching his body, Wu Qing began to pay attention to the new actions in the Great Xia territory.

On the third day after the Great Xia Territory was renamed and its lord was changed, the lord finally issued another order after issuing the order to recruit talents, called the order of work-for-relief.

According to the explanation of the mysterious voice that issued the order, if you work for the lord, you can get food.

"Aren't we all working for the lord?!"

All the residents of the territory were confused. What is this new lord going to do?
